entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.530/2022 registered at Police Station Gohparu, District Shahdol (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 366, 376 and 34 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is major and she was a consenting party.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge-sheet has already been filed.
In these circumstances, he may be released on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that offence committed by applicant is serious in nature.

In these circumstance,
bail application may be dismissed.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

5. Considering the fact that prosecutrix is major, charge-sheet has been filed, prosecutrix and applicant were known to each other and they were in relationship, therefore, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/-
(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr. P. C.
8. C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
